## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (76%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Benign · Careful review
Benign (20%) stays in the 90% prediction set [F1], with positive simulated frozen margins [F7] and deeper levels drafted.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 76%, Benign 20%, Normal 2%, Invasive 2% | Favors InSitu; low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% target coverage; test 90%) | Cannot exclude Benign at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 98th OOD percentile (12/12 tiles) [F6] | Unflagged quality; high OOD percentile |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree (same top class) | Independent backbones match each other |
| Similar cases | 2/5 InSitu, 3/5 Normal (86–89% similarity) [F5] | Mixed neighbors; top match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Scarce (-0.51 SD, contribution -0.36); pushes against invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Prominent (+1.11 SD, contribution -0.34); favors non-invasive call [F3] · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Typical level (-0.43 SD, contribution +0.28); descriptive only [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Low (-0.70 SD, contribution -0.26); failed AI check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Elevated (+0.60 SD, contribution -0.23); failed check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive risk beyond random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002 to 0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (deletion CI -0.009 to 0.006 includes 0); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Ductal changes in regions 0–2 are benign (20% probability) or normal (3/5 neighbors, top match BACH_0207).
- Simulated composite frozen section (98th OOD percentile) misses deeper lesion; deeper levels are drafted, stains blocked.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 2**: Verify duct-confined atypia versus benign lesion, and check the 645 um superior margin.
2. **Regions 3, 7**: Highest risk tiles (9%, 5%); exclude stromal invasion and check 215 um lateral margin.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8**: Assess 108 um medial margin and confirm need for drafted deeper levels.
